Label: Mission Commander
Description: Human mission authority responsible for final mission-level decisions and escalation outcomes.

Label: Human Governance Authority
Description: Human governance role responsible for oversight rules, accountability, and authority boundaries.

Label: Policy and Compliance Authority
Description: Human policy role responsible for policy interpretation, compliance expectations, and governance constraints.

Label: Human Analyst
Description: Human analyst who interprets model outputs, compares evidence, and advises mission leadership.

Label: Human Operator
Description: Human operator who directly controls or monitors operational automation in lower-autonomy scenarios.

Label: Supervisory AI
Description: AI layer that coordinates lower-level autonomous systems and returns exceptions to human governance.

Label: Assurance AI
Description: Independent AI layer that checks supervisory behavior, assurance conditions, and unresolved risk.

Label: Policy AI
Description: AI layer that applies machine-readable policy constraints to supervisory decisions.

Label: Validation AI
Description: AI service that validates generated or agent-produced outputs before downstream use.

Label: Mission Agent
Description: Agentic system that converts mission intent into delegated tasks and manages mission-level execution.

Label: Planning Agent
Description: Agentic system that produces plans and issues tasks to operational models and automation.

Label: Collection Agent
Description: Agentic system that coordinates collection requests and ingests sensor information.

Label: Analysis Agent
Description: Agentic system that analyzes collected information and shares findings with planning functions.

Label: Logistics Agent
Description: Agentic system that coordinates resource and logistics decisions with operational models.

Label: Coordination Agent
Description: Multi-agent coordinator that synchronizes specialized agents and reduces conflicting actions.

Label: Generative AI System
Description: Generative AI system that synthesizes information and recommends options to human or agent users.

Label: Decision Support Model
Description: Traditional analytical model that combines available data and produces decision-support outputs.

Label: Routing Automation
Description: Deterministic automation that executes approved routing or sequencing instructions.

Label: Task Scheduler
Description: Automation service that schedules approved tasks and execution windows.

Label: Resource Allocation Model
Description: Operational model that allocates synthetic resources based on priorities and logistics inputs.

Label: Imagery Sensor
Description: Synthetic sensor source that produces imagery observations for collection and analysis tasks.

Label: Environmental Sensor
Description: Synthetic sensor source that produces environmental observations used by models and agents.

Label: Logistics Data Feed
Description: Synthetic logistics information feed containing availability and movement data.

Label: Mission Data Repository
Description: Synthetic repository containing approved mission context, reference information, and prior outputs.

Label: External Information Feed
Description: Synthetic external information source used for broader context in generative and autonomous scenarios.
